tasks.build: deno task --cwd packages/frontend build && deno task --cwd packages/helper compile && deno desktop packages/backend/main.ts --config deno.desktop.json --include packages/frontend/dist --exclude-unused-npm --compress --allow-all
tasks.package:deb: deno task build && deno run -A npm:@goreleaser/nfpm pkg --packager deb
tasks.package:rpm: deno task build && deno run -A npm:@goreleaser/nfpm pkg --packager rpm
